What awaits you
The opportunity to define and set standards that guide how Angular applications are built across multiple feature teams
A key role in mentoring and coaching developers, raising overall technical maturity
Agile development workspace in an iterative and incremental manner
Ownership of the Angular frontend architecture, shaping scalable, consistent, and future‑proof solutions
Leadership in Angular upgrades, migrations, and modernization, keeping the frontend landscape up to date

Responsibility for designing complex, business‑critical frontend solutions and making key architectural decisions
Accountability for performance, security, quality, and testability at frontend level
 What should you bring along
University Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field
Minimum 7 years of experience with Angular in large-scale applications
Strong understanding of frontend architecture patterns and design principles
Solid knowledge of performance optimization, security, and accessibility in frontend applications
Ability to operate across multiple teams and stakeholders
Experience with projects with end-customer focus
High analytical thinking skills and level of quality awareness
Self-motivated and a high willingness to learn
Excellent English verbal and written skills
German communication skills will be a plus
